title: Photo thumbnail workers: a queue consumer that stops pulling work
name: Thumbnail queue consumer

questions.prompt: During last night's object-storage incident the thumbnail workers threw a burst of 503s. Storage recovered within minutes, but the workers never did: queue depth kept climbing, new listings went up with no thumbnails, and the processes were up and healthy, just idle. Restarting them cleared it. The marketplace backfill job now also dies with "consumer stalled" whenever storage flakes. Fix the consumer so the tests pass.
